bracketing_exemplars: New Mexico QB 2025 (34, exemplar anchor context)
rationale_bullets: Christopher Vizzina (former top-100, 3 years as Klubnik's backup) is the favorite to start - 54.1/81 (56.2 adj), limited to 105 career attempts, 'solid in his first start vs SMU.'
Klubnik (76.5, the star, 33-6 TD-INT) GONE to the NFL. Backup true-Fr Reynolds.
An unproven QB1 at a top program - the pedigree + strong supporting cast lift the floor, but 81 snaps is thin. Swinney's 'significant gamble.'
48: the swing of Clemson's season; ~ Virginia Tech QB 48. L (unproven).
Gideon Davidson (returning, 74.6 adj, small sample - former top recruit) + Chris Johnson Jr. (SMU, 76.5 adj, small sample) - 'a strong 1-2 punch.'
Lost Adam Randall (yr4).
Two talented backs on small samples behind a rebuilt OL.
52: the talent argues up; the samples + OL rebuild temper it.
Two future pros return: Bryant Wesco (77.2 adj) + T.J. Moore (73.2) + Tyler Brown + TEs Patt-Henry + Bentancur (66.4).
Lost Antonio Williams (80.3, NFL).
A genuinely strong room even without Williams - two future-pro WRs + TE depth. Top-2 adj ~75 -> WRTE p65+.
56: the future-pro top-end; above California WRTE 54.
Replaces 3 of 5 - lost Miller (elite T, NFL) + Linthicum (C) + Leigh (T), all yr4.
Returns Sewell (C, 63.8 adj) + Sadler (G, 60.2) + Brayden Jacobs (LT, 75.4 - a bright spot); young Thurmon + Fr Ware.
2-3 returners + young/inexperienced pieces at a top program - 'seeking consistency.'
48: more pedigree than a typical rebuild; the inexperience + lost-Miller cap it. L.
